title: Local Theatre plugin manifest
description: Keep in sync with Manifest in plugins/sdk/types.ts and checkManifest in plugins/sdk/manifest.ts.

id.description: Must match the folder name (without the leading "_" of a dev-only folder). Prefixes the app-wide film keys, e.g. "vic:385117".

author.description: Who wrote the plugin, shown in the theatre's info in Settings.

updated.description: When the plugin last changed, e.g. "2026-10-18".

owner.description: Who runs the theatre, if not obvious from its name; named in the About disclaimer.

posterSource.description: With a TMDB key set, the app shows The Movie Database's posters ("database", the default); "theatre" opts this plugin out.

titleExtras.description: Event wording cut out of titles when looking films up on The Movie Database, e.g. ["Fright Fest", "Director's Cut", "w/*"]. A trailing * also cuts everything after.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a run may take before the host stops it. For slow sites.

enabledByDefault.description: Whether it's switched on for a fresh install.
